name: verdix-mcp
description: Check an EVM address on Base before sending it funds: safe, caution or danger. Pays per call in USDC via x402 from your own wallet.
long_description:
Verdix screens an EVM address on Base before your agent sends it money: OFAC sanctions, scam and phishing lists, address-poisoning lookalikes, contract provenance, burn addresses and more. It answers safe, caution or danger with the reasons.

Each check is paid per call in USDC on Base via x402, from a wallet you configure here (quick $0.02, standard $0.10, deep $0.50). There's no account and no API key. Your private key is stored in your OS keychain and used only locally to sign each payment. A price cap refuses anything more expensive before signing.

private_key.title: Wallet private key (Base)
private_key.description: Private key of a DEDICATED Base wallet holding a few dollars of USDC (no ETH needed). Used only on this computer to sign each payment; never sent anywhere. Leave empty to use only the free get_pricing tool.

max_price_usd.title: Max price per check (USD)
max_price_usd.description: Most one check may cost. quick = $0.02, standard = $0.10, deep = $0.50. Anything above is refused before signing.

tools.name: check_address_risk
tools.description: Paid: screen an EVM address on Base before sending it funds (safe / caution / danger, with reasons).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free: current price per tier, your price cap and your wallet's public address.
